# remotion-ai-hub

> Central hub for making videos with Remotion using AI coding agents: ZCode (GLM 5.3 Flash), Claude Code, OpenCode, Trae, Codex. Guides, prompts, agent skills, templates, QA tools, gotchas.

Remotion is React-for-video: frame-perfect programmatic video rendered server-side. This hub connects it to AI coding agents with everything needed to go from prompt to finished MP4.

## Start here

- Quick start: `npx create-video --yes --blank my-video && cd my-video && npm i && npx skills add remotion-dev/skills`
- Agent guides: docs/agents/zcode-glm.md (GLM 5.3 Flash, deepest), docs/agents/claude-code.md, docs/agents/opencode.md, docs/agents/trae.md
- Architecture patterns: docs/patterns.md
- Headless rendering gotchas: docs/gotchas.md
- Curated links: docs/resources.md

## Prompts (copy-paste)

- prompts/01-scaffold.md — scaffold a project brief
- prompts/02-explainer.md — multi-scene explainer
- prompts/03-subtitles.md — burnt-in subtitles
- prompts/04-brand-kit.md — brand-locked styling
- prompts/05-data-driven.md — data.ts driven videos
- prompts/06-qa-fix-loop.md — render-verify-fix loop
- prompts/07-vertical-short.md — 1080x1920 Shorts with safe zones
- prompts/08-lambda-cloud.md — Remotion Lambda cloud rendering

## Examples

- examples/README.md — real rendered frames + clip from the starter template
- examples/frames/*.jpg — scene keyframes (actual Remotion renders)
- examples/demo-clip.mp4 — 8-second clip, rendered at 1/3 scale

## Tools

- tools/remotion-qa.mjs — post-render QA: blank/frozen frame detection, duration check
- tools/agent-rules/remotion-rules.md — paste into any agent's rules file

## Templates

- templates/explainer-starter/ — working multi-scene TypeScript starter

## Official resources

- Docs: https://www.remotion.dev/docs (append .md for markdown, e.g. https://www.remotion.dev/docs/player.md)
- AI docs: https://www.remotion.dev/docs/ai
- Official agent skills: https://www.remotion.dev/docs/ai/skills (npx skills add remotion-dev/skills)
- Coding agents workflow: https://www.remotion.dev/docs/ai/coding-agents
- License: https://www.remotion.dev/docs/license
